ops.sql: SELECT TOP 8 o2.Name AS proces FROM t_connector c INNER JOIN t_object o2 ON o2.Object_ID = c.End_Object_ID WHERE c.Start_Object_ID = <ID-KOMPONENTA> AND c.Stereotype = 'ArchiMate_Serving' AND o2.Stereotype = 'ArchiMate_BusinessProcess' ORDER BY o2.Name

SELECT TOP 8 o2.Name AS sluzba FROM t_connector c INNER JOIN t_object o2 ON o2.Object_ID = c.End_Object_ID WHERE c.Start_Object_ID = <ID-KOMPONENTA> AND c.Stereotype = 'ArchiMate_Realization' AND o2.Stereotype = 'ArchiMate_ApplicationService' ORDER BY o2.Name
